description: This file implements an event queue data structure using a linked list, managing scheduled events with functions for insertion, execution, and management of pending events. It includes classes 'scheduling_s' and 'EventQueue' with methods for handling event scheduling, execution, and list management.

classes.name: scheduling_s
classes.description: Represents a scheduled event with callback, timing, and status information.

classes.name: EventQueue
classes.description: Manages a linked list of scheduled events, providing methods to insert, execute, and manage pending events.

methods.name: checkIfPending
methods.description: Checks if a scheduling object is pending in the queue.

methods.name: insertTask
methods.description: Inserts a new scheduled task into the queue at the appropriate position based on time.

methods.name: getNextEventTime
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the next scheduled event, or a future time if the next event is in the past.

methods.name: executeAll
methods.description: Executes all pending events up to the specified current time.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of scheduled events in the queue.

methods.name: assertListIsSorted
methods.description: Debug method to verify the list is sorted by event time.

methods.name: setLateDelay
methods.description: Sets the delay used when an event is late.

methods.name: getHead
methods.description: Returns the head of the event list.

methods.name: getForUnitText
methods.description: Retrieves a scheduled event by index.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all scheduled events from the queue.
